title: Chocolate Mousse
description: The essence of a mousse is lightness, indicated by it's French name meaning foam or froth. This favourite is delicate yet rich with cream and chocolate.

method.instruction: Place chocolate in heatproof bowl and place over pan of simmering water. Stir choclate until melts then remove from heat.
Add butter, stir until melted. Stir in egg yolks, 1 at a time; transfer mixture to a large bowl, cover, cool.
Beat egg whites in a small bowl with electric mixer until medium soft peaks form.

Whip the cream until stiff DO NOT OVER MIX... We already have the butter... 
Soft peaks
Gently fold in cream and egg whites alternatly a third at a time into the cooled chocolate mixture.
Pour or spoon into serving dishes, cover with plastic wrap, refigerate over night.

notes.title: Whipping Egg Whites
notes.content: DO NOT over-whip the whites or you will get a grainy texture in the final result...

notes.title: Restaurant finish
notes.content: Serve with extra whipped cream and chocolate curls, if desired.
